title: LEGIC Smart Cards
description: LEGIC smart cards for secure access, hospitality, mobility and multi-application identity programs, available for authorized LEGIC credential projects.
summary: LEGIC smart cards are used in secure enterprise, hospitality, mobility and industrial ID systems where the project requires LEGIC-based multi-application credentials.

High security: Enabling secure and trusted interactions between people and things. LEGIC is one of the most secure RFID system, widely deployed by the world’s most famous company, such as BMW, Boeing, Alibaba, etc.
Long reading distance: LEGIC card normally can be read at a longer distance.
